title: WU JEN NINTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 13 ninth level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R678 OA wu jen ninth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty-five (capture pp. 213-216): the wu jen ninth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes - the round closing the wu jen spell book grid

banner.title: WU JEN NINTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 213-216 - the OA wu jen ninth level spells round, the wu jen spell book closer
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 213-216; compressed pp. 97-98); all 13 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the roster pages carrying two garbles against the stat blocks (Instant Regenerate and Power Word. III for the Instant Regeneration and Power Word, Kill the stat-block headings print in both passes, roster-only variances outside the grid), and the crystalbrittle print running the Duration and save lines together with the save reading Special in both passes. SIX nine-segment casts - astral spell, crystalbrittle, gate, imprisonment, shape change, time stop - the ninth level signature and the most common cast of the level; the opening quartet astral spell, crystalbrittle, gate and imprisonment all take verbal and somatic only. Conjuration the most common school at five spells (gate, planar call, power word kill, summon spirit, wish); alteration three, evocation three; imprisonment the lone abjuration and the one reversible spell, instant regeneration the lone necromantic; NO enchantment/charm, divination, invocation or illusion spell this level - ONE dual-school print, summon spirit the Conjuration/Summoning; Necromantic dual pinned primary conjuration 4, the exaction precedent. Wish carries BOTH the Casting Time: Special line (pinned -1, the R662 exorcise convention) and the special save; power word kill, time stop and wish the three verbal-only spells; three one-turn casts (planar call, summon spirit, tsunami); instant regeneration and internal fire the one-round casts; power word kill the lone single segment. Summon spirit the lone negation save; crystalbrittle, planar call and wish special; tsunami the lone half save. The element column cross-checks the R669 dieWJT66L9Element grid: the THREE tagged cells matching exactly - crystalbrittle Earth, internal fire Fire, tsunami Water - the cross-check column closing the wu jen spell book grid
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 131 closed, 104 open - the wu jen Ninth Level Spells box flips (census 600 -> 601), the WU JEN SPELL BOOK GRID CLOSED - all nine levels pinned; NEXT - R679: the OA Chapter 9 Combat arc opens - the Summary of the Combat Sequence (capture p. 218), prefix dip (verify free - only the comment-word dips, the R669 die precedent), audit "R679 OA combat sequence audit"
